chain.note: The two chains are the same tree, from the bank-exchange network through frames, labels, s<Wm, tau, the two recurrences, the transforms, the resampling reduction and the exact recovery to the time bound. They differ only at the point where the central saving is established: Plan A's S1.5.6 derives L<N/2 from the exact ratios 100/539 and 101/539 (lines 1105-1110) before S1.5.7/S1.5.9 state the deficits. Plan B asserts L<N/2 only in the S1.5 claim, so its chain is slightly thinner there.

overall.reason: A full comparison shows the plans identical except for Plan A's step S1.5.6, which states the exact loss ratios L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 (<1/2) from lines 1105-1110. This is checklist sub-step L5 and the explicit ground for L<N/2 behind the strict saving s<Wm. No step in either plan misstates the paper. The only difference is one constant-level sub-step on a core item, so Plan A is preferred, slightly.
